0.name: SUBMITTED
0.meaning: bid made, waiting for the selling club's response
0.evidence: add_transfer_offer writes 0; process_due_offer case 0 = seller response (accept_transfer_bid / ai_respond_to_bid); 0x11/0x12 go back to 0 for a new round

1.name: ON_HOLD
1.meaning: offer held while its terms are negotiated (negotiation slot open)
1.evidence: put_offer_on_hold sets 1 (manager_manager.rs 2618); transfer_manager.rs 5735 'the offer under negotiation'

2.name: REJECTED
2.evidence: fields.rs offer::STATUS '2 rejected'; transfer_manager doc 'estado 2 (recusada)'; closed set {2,3,4,0x10,0x14}

4.name: LAPSED
4.meaning: a human party did not answer by the deadline; the offer is closed and removed when due again
4.evidence: process_due_offer: case 0 with a human seller and case 1 with a human buyer set 4 and reschedule; when due, 4 is removed like 2/3/0xf/0x10/0x14

5.name: ACCEPTED
5.meaning: the selling club accepted the bid
5.evidence: fields.rs '5 accepted'; accept_transfer_bid '+0x2e = 0, status 5'; due 5/6 -> contract offered to the target

6.name: ACCEPTED_EXCHANGE_TERMS_SET
6.meaning: accepted, terms already offered to every exchange player; next is the target's contract
6.evidence: note_terms_offered_to_exchange_player: no exchange item left unmarked -> 8 if it was 7, else 6; due 5/6 -> offer_contract_to_offer_player

7.name: PRE_CONTRACT
7.meaning: pre-contract offer (no fee to a seller); terms still to be offered to the exchange players
7.evidence: add_transfer_offer: with pre_contract (+0x2f) status 7 (28 days if the buyer is human); due 7 with an exchange -> contracts to the exchange players

8.name: AWAITING_PLAYER_DECISION
8.meaning: agreed with the clubs; the player's decision on the contract is pending
8.evidence: after acceptance: schedule_decision_for_transfer then status 8 and the accepted news; 7 -> 8 once the exchange terms are set

9.name: AWAITING_HUMAN_CONTRACT_OFFER
9.meaning: accepted; the human buyer has to offer the player a contract
9.evidence: process_due_offer: 5/6 with a human buyer -> 9 and 10 days

10.name: AWAITING_WORK_PERMIT
10.meaning: waiting for the work permit decision
10.evidence: advance_offer_to_club_approval: permit to request -> work-permit delay news, status 0xa, 18+random(7) days; due 0xa -> check_offer_work_permits

11.name: AWAITING_CLUB_CONFIRMATIONS
11.meaning: deal agreed; both clubs still have to confirm
11.evidence: advance_offer_to_club_approval sets 0xb; state_after_approval moves 0xb to 0xd (buyer) or 0xc (other side)

12.name: SELLER_CONFIRMED
12.meaning: the selling side confirmed; the buyer has not

13.name: BUYER_CONFIRMED
13.meaning: the buyer confirmed; the selling side has not

14.name: BOTH_CONFIRMED
14.meaning: both clubs confirmed; the transfer is completed when due

15.name: COLLAPSED
15.meaning: the deal fell through (player refused to move, or a rival offer went ahead); another round may follow while +0x2e < 3
15.evidence: post_player_rejects_move_news then status 0xf with +0x2e = 3; rival offers fall to 0xf; due 0xf with +0x2e < 3 gets one more round

16.name: CANCELLED
16.meaning: offer cancelled (loan refused, work permit refused, no player sheet); removed when due
16.evidence: post_loan_cancelled_news / post_offer_collapsed_news then 0x10; target without a player sheet -> 0x10 in 1 day

17.name: REFUSED_BY_SELLING_SIDE
17.meaning: the selling side refused at the approval stage; the offer goes back to the clubs
17.evidence: club_rejects_offer: refusing club is not the buyer (+8) -> 0x11 and unsettle_player_after_bid; due 0x11/0x12 -> status 0 again

18.name: REFUSED_BY_BUYER
18.meaning: the buying club refused at the approval stage; the offer goes back to the clubs
18.evidence: club_rejects_offer: refusing club id = buyer (+8) -> 0x12; due 0x11/0x12 -> status 0 again

19.name: FUTURE_TRANSFER
19.meaning: agreed transfer that completes at a later date
19.evidence: fields.rs '0x13 future transfer'; set with +0x2d = 1 when the future transfer is registered (transfer_manager.rs 6920); list lookups for status 0x13

20.name: COMPLETED
20.meaning: transfer or loan completed; removed when due
20.evidence: after finalise_transfer / move_player_to_club / the loan records: status 0x14 rescheduled (5 or 10 days), then removed

0.name: PROMOTED

1.name: PROMOTION_PLAYOFF
1.evidence: table key: 1 and 2 -> 'Pl<%s - COMMENT - playoffs>'; update_positions_and_status band 1 (+0xbf) -> 1

3.name: RELEGATED

5.name: CHAMPIONS

6.name: QUALIFIED
6.meaning: qualified for the next stage (band 0 with rule flag 8)

7.name: QUALIFIED_7
7.meaning: qualified (band 0 with rule flag 4); how it differs from 6 is not known
7.evidence: table key: 7 -> 'Q' qualified; update_positions_and_status writes 7 with league_flags bit 4

252.name: PROMOTION_INELIGIBLE
252.meaning: cannot go up (B team of a top-division club); can still be relegated

254.name: OUT_OF_CONTENTION

255.evidence: fields.rs league_table_row::STATUS '0xff = not decided yet'; reset to 0xff after promotion/relegation and at the new season
